headline: Earnings per share more than double the prior quarter
summary_short: Swedish Logistic Property's Q3 2026 EPS was SEK 1.20 versus SEK 0.52 in Q2, a 131% sequential rise; the nine-month report was published October 15, 2026.
summary_long: Only the EPS figure is verified from shard data. Search snippets of the January-September report cite continued portfolio growth, about 80,000 square meters of projects under way with SEK 700M of investment, and an expected SEK 50M of added net operating income by end of 2027. The report itself was not read.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary from verified shard data. Only the shard EPS is used as a number; the interim report's period labels could not be matched to Q3 versus nine months, so its other figures are omitted. The EPS delta is computed from shard values 1.20 and 0.52.
